published_surfaces.assessment: Every commit reachable from an origin/* ref is published on the remote named above, including blobs later deleted from the tip. A DOI is only exposure if the archival docs say one exists; docs/ARCHIVAL.md states that no DOI has been minted in this snapshot, so the Zenodo surface is prepared-but-unpublished.

records_written_breakdown.note: the original v1 publication count: every jsonl/ row plus every splits_v2/ pointer row (945, including the 2 quarantined cross-split duplicates). It counts pointers, not distinct records: a finding and its exploit/patch rows share an id, and each split row points back at a jsonl row. Distinct canonical ids are 722 findings+negatives; jsonl/ holds 953 rows; derived/ holds 722 derived records. This key is kept as the historical publish figure because audit_pre_upgrade.py pins it (v1_manifest_records_written).

publish_manifest.release_scope_note: This file records the v1 publish/redaction pass. It is not the statement of what may be redistributed: RELEASE_MANIFEST.json is, path by path, and it is the only statement of the release boundary. The v1 counts below describe what the redactor removed from the v1 layer; they do not count the third-party material that is still present in the research tree, which the manifest marks as withheld or as an internal research artefact.

zenodo_metadata.description: A provenance-preserving corpus of smart-contract security findings across Solidity, Rust, Move, Cairo, Circom, Noir, Leo, TypeScript, Go, Vyper and Clarity. Every record traces to a public artefact and every claim carries its evidence type. Governing rule: truth over scale; unknown is a counted outcome. The licence is scoped, not blanket: this project grants MIT over its own code and CC BY 4.0 over its own documents and data, and only for the paths RELEASE_MANIFEST.json lists with a released rights status. The evidence corpus and every piece of third-party material are not licensed here at all, and attribution is not a redistribution right (see LICENSE and NOTICE.md).
zenodo_metadata.notes: There is no single repository-wide licence: the licence is per path, and RELEASE_MANIFEST.json is the authoritative statement of what may be redistributed. Fill the deposition's licence field from that manifest's `path_licences` for the released paths, and do not claim a licence over the evidence corpus. DOI is minted by Zenodo on first publish (see docs/ARCHIVAL.md). After publishing, copy the DOI back into CITATION.cff (doi: + preferred-citation.doi) and regenerate the README so the citable artifact is pinned in-repo.
